title: Storage and durability
brief: Connect logical updates to pages, buffers, retained row versions and cleanup, distinguishing reusable space, file shrinkage and write amplification. Explain write-ahead ordering, commit durability and restart recovery, and separate them from recovery after lost storage or an unwanted committed change.

neighbouring_ownership.backups: Owns restorable history and recovery reconciliation.
neighbouring_ownership.replicas: Owns copied history, progress and read routing.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-vacuum: Owns native retention diagnosis and transaction age.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-wal: Owns native settings and crash drills.
